articles.headline: OECD Upgrades India's Economic Growth
articles.whyItMatters: Boosts global investor confidence in emerging market resilience amid trade tensions.
articles.brief: The OECD has upgraded India's 2026-27 economic expansion forecast to 7.1%, following similar moves by major global rating agencies.

articles.headline: Trump-Xi Summit Kicks Off in Washington
articles.whyItMatters: Shapes international trade rules, tech decoupling, and regional security dynamics globally.
articles.brief: Chinese President Xi Jinping arrived in Washington for high-stakes talks with US counterpart Donald Trump covering trade, AI, and Taiwan.

articles.headline: Supreme Court Refers EC Appointment Law
articles.whyItMatters: Impacts the constitutional autonomy of India's election oversight and democratic integrity.
articles.brief: The Supreme Court has officially referred petitions challenging the Chief Election Commissioner appointment law to a five-judge Constitution Bench.

articles.headline: OMCs Face Crushing Fuel Price Losses
articles.whyItMatters: Threatens state refiner profit margins and increases fiscal subsidies burden.
articles.brief: Indian oil marketing companies are facing massive daily fuel losses of Rs 530 crore as international crude prices surge.

articles.headline: Mirabai Chanu Wins Asian Games Silver
articles.whyItMatters: Marks a historic resurgence for Indian weightlifting on the international multi-sport stage.
articles.brief: Tokyo Olympic silver medallist Mirabai Chanu lifted 198kg to secure silver in the women's 49kg event at the 2026 Asian Games.

articles.headline: Ultra-Processed Foods Linked to Heart Risks
articles.whyItMatters: Highlights growing public health crises associated with modern dietary habits.
articles.brief: A new study reveals that consuming an extra 100 grams of ultra-processed foods daily raises heart event risks by 14%.

articles.headline: China Surveys Broadcom Switch Usage
articles.whyItMatters: Accelerates global technology supply chain decoupling and indigenous hardware shifts.
articles.brief: China is reportedly surveying the use of Broadcom network switches within its state data centers as part of domestic tech substitution.

articles.headline: India Probes Samsung and LG Over Tariffs
articles.whyItMatters: Signals stricter custom enforcement on electronic component imports and manufacturer compliance.
articles.brief: India has launched an investigation into major electronics giants Samsung and LG over alleged tariff evasion on imported OLED TV parts.

articles.headline: India-Middle East Corridor Gains Backing
articles.whyItMatters: Redraws regional trade architecture and bypasses traditional supply chain chokepoints.
articles.brief: US President Trump has thrown renewed political weight behind the stalled India-Middle East-Europe Economic Corridor project.

articles.headline: Banks to Open Sunday Ahead of Strike
articles.whyItMatters: Seeks to mitigate severe nationwide public inconvenience during major union actions.
articles.brief: Public sector banks will remain open on Sunday to clear transactions ahead of an upcoming three-day nationwide union strike.

articles.headline: Apple Shifts to In-House Custom Silicon
articles.whyItMatters: Reduces dependency on external component manufacturers while optimizing device performance.
articles.brief: Apple executives highlighted a profound 20-year strategic shift toward proprietary custom silicon and in-house technology development.

articles.headline: Measles Outbreaks Spark US Health Alarms
articles.whyItMatters: Raises international concerns regarding declining vaccination coverage and disease resurgences.
articles.brief: A sharp surge in highly contagious measles cases has triggered localized outbreaks across major US transport hubs and regions.
